title: Weak continuity of Jacobian minors under uniform convergence with bounded Lipschitz constants, L¹ weights (parent steps 3 and 6)
statement: Let k, r ∈ ℕ, L ∈ ℝ≥0, g^j_c, g_c : ℝᵏ → ℝ (j ∈ ℕ, c ∈ Fin r) L-Lipschitz with g^j_c → g_c uniformly on ℝᵏ as j → ∞ for every c, V_0, …, V_{r−1} ∈ ℝᵏ and φ : ℝᵏ → ℝ Lebesgue integrable (ℝᵏ = Euclid k; D = fderiv ℝ, the zero map at non-differentiability points). Then ∫ φ(x)·det(Dg^j_c(x)V_b)_{c,b ∈ Fin r} dx → ∫ φ(x)·det(Dg_c(x)V_b)_{c,b ∈ Fin r} dx as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (k r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (gs : ℕ → Fin r → Euclid k → ℝ) (g : Fin r → Euclid k → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Euclid k) (φ : Euclid k → ℝ), Integrable φ → (∀ j c, LipschitzWith L (gs j c)) → (∀ c, LipschitzWith L (g c)) → (∀ c, TendstoUniformly (fun j => gs j c) (g c) atTop) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, φ x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (gs j c) x (V b))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, φ x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (g c) x (V b))))
